# Geoff Southern

Geoff Southern is the current Deputy of [District 5](https://flow.je/elections/district-5) and a member of [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). He was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2002.

Geoff Southern has participated in 10 elections since 2002:

- [**2002 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/geoff-southern#e3)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 2 with 53.3% of the ballot.
- [**2005 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/geoff-southern#e6)

  Not elected.
- [**2005 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/geoff-southern#e7)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 2 with 46.4% of the ballot.
- [**2008 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/geoff-southern#e10)

  Not elected.

  - [2008 Full Manifesto](http://jerseyelections.info/senators/geoff-southern.html)
- [**2008 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/geoff-southern#e12)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 2 with 62.7% of the ballot.
- [**2010 Senator By-Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/geoff-southern#e13)

  Not elected.

  - [2010 Full Manifesto](http://news.bbc.co.uk/local/jersey/hi/people_and_places/the_states/newsid_8721000/8721502.stm)
- [**2011 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/geoff-southern#e15)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 2 with 41.3% of the ballot.

  - [2011 Vote.je Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20111016221107/http://www.vote.je:80/candidates/deputies/st-helier-district-2/geoff-southern/)
- [**2014 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/geoff-southern#e20)

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20230328184008/https://archive.vote.je/portfolio/southern-geoff/)
